ARTICLE 2. ZONING DISTRICTS

§ 25-2-491. PERMITTED USES.

(A) The following uses are permitted in the CS-1 (Commercial — Liquor Sales) district: all uses permitted in the CS district, and liquor sales.

(B) A use must comply with the site development standards of this article.

StandardCS-1 Requirement
Maximum building height60 feet
Maximum floor area ratio0.5 to 1
Minimum lot size5,750 square feet

§ 25-2-492. SITE DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

(A) This section applies to commercial and industrial zoning districts including CS, CS-1, and LI.

(B) Impervious cover may not exceed 80 percent of the site area in a CS-1 district.

§ 25-8-211. WATER QUALITY CONTROL REQUIREMENTS.

(A) A development may not discharge stormwater runoff that exceeds the limits established by the Environmental Criteria Manual.

(B) A water quality control must be designed to capture and treat the first one-half inch of runoff from the contributing drainage area.
